Dask is an open-source project, which means there are a lot of people we’d like to thank from code contributors to corporate support to the projects using Dask. And, as a successful open-source project, there are some stats to crow about, too. Collectively, maintained by hundreds of open source contributors across dozens of companies.
Dask is installed by default in Anaconda
Coiled makes Dask infrastructure accessible to everyone
Dask integrates with RAPIDS cuDF, XGBoost, and RAPIDS cuML for GPU-accelerated data analytics and machine learning.
Saturn Cloud lets users create Dask clusters in a hosted platform or within their own AWS accounts.
These companies are part of the larger Dask community. They’re either well-integrated with Dask or use Dask to power components of their infrastructure.
